_about: Logistic coefficients for the in-season future-pick blend, by completed regular-season week (a later week uses the last one). P(championship bracket) = sigmoid(b0 + b_prior * logit(owner playoff rate, k=4) + b_ap * z(All-Play %) + b_pf * z(points for)), z-scored across the league. Fitted on seasons 2011-2025 (finishes from the bracket games), ridge 1.0, by pipelines/etl/scripts/backtest_pick_slot_model.py --write-config. Valid for seasons after 2025: never fitted on the season it scores.
